verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents its own dashboards built from reports: an MCP 'Create-Dashboard' tool adds text cards and reports to a new dashboard, and marketing copy describes a dashboard 'you and your team can keep working from.' However, there is no dedicated dashboard documentation and no detail on how saved reports are added or how sharing works. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on composing saved reports into dashboards in the UI, documented sharing and permission controls for teammates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can compose saved insights into shareable dashboards for my team
